cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a night observatory under an open dome — holds a book closed against her chest; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; holds one end of a towel hung around her neck; a night-train sleeper compartment with a narrow berth — holds a cup at chest height; an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — swimming breaststroke; a futuristic spa of white curves and soft light — standing; a starship galley and mess hall — dries her hair with a towel; a snowy mountain-lodge terrace with a wooden railing and benches above a winter valley — holds a smartphone up at arm's length to take a selfie; a small bakery workroom with a floury wooden worktable and warm ovens — standing; a starship data archive — examines a small object on the table through a magnifying glass; a retro-futurist home of rounded chrome appliances and soft panels — lying on her side; her bedroom — standing; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — holds one end of a towel hung around her neck
